name: 奇数和子序列的数量
englishName: Number of Subsequences with Odd Sum
hints: Define dp[i][0] as the answer for the subarray [0, i].
Similarly define dp[i][1] as the answer for the subarray [0, i] if we wanted to count even-sum subsequences.
dp[0][0] = 2 if nums[0] is even, and 1 otherwise (since an empty subsequence has an even sum).
